_about: Field catalogue for the EU Data Act portal's ONE-TIME / historical export (the legacy Car-Net RBC/RTS/RDT/RPC dialect). Descriptions are the official ones from the portal operator's public Data Dictionary V4.0 (Historical Data), joined by data-point UUID against a real export. The raw dictionary PDF is intentionally NOT committed (it is the portal operator's copyrighted document; this repo is public). This catalogue is the machine-usable extract: it lets a scout report on a legacy field carry its real name instead of showing up as 'new'. Field paths are index-normalised ([*]). 'mapped_to' names the VehicleData attribute when we already map it.
_source: SVK EU Data Act — List of Historical Data, V4.0 (public portal download), UUID-joined against a real GTE export 2026-07-17.

RDT.timerBasicSettings.[*].climatisation.official: Flag whether regulating the temperature is allowed without a power source

RPC.climaterSettings.[*].climatisationWi.official: Flag whether regulating the temperature is allowed without a power source

RPC.climaterSettings.[*].targetTemperatu.official: Target temperature measurement state (enum, e.g. VALID)

RDT.timerBackendSettings.[*].connectPlug.official: Time span until departure to notify if vehicle is connected

RDT.timerBackendSettings.[*].departRemin.official: Time span for notification of scheduled departure time

RDT.timerProfileElements.[*].profileName.note: per-profile list (up to 10) — belongs in an attribute, not one entity each

RDT.timerProfileElements.[*].chargeMaxCu.official: Max allowed amperage of the power source to be drawn

RDT.timerProfileElements.[*].nightRateAc.official: Flag whether night-time power should be used

RDT.timerElements.[*].timerFequency.official: Frequency of the timer (sic — the portal spells it 'Fequency')

RDT.timerStatusData.[*].instrumentCluste.official: Current time displayed in the vehicle

RDT.timerStatusData.[*].timerExpiredStat.official: Expired means a timer has started its actions

RTS.tripData.[*].mileage.note: logbook — 727 anonymous trip distances, no timestamps; aggregate, don't spawn one entity each
